description: This file defines the 'EachPromise' class, which manages iterating over multiple promises, with controls for concurrency, and invokes callback functions on promise fulfillment or rejection within the GuzzleHttp Promise library.

classes.name: EachPromise
classes.description: Manages multiple promises, iterates over them with optional concurrency limits, and invokes callbacks on fulfillment or rejection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an 'EachPromise' instance with an iterable of promises/values and a configuration array.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns the aggregate promise representing all managed promises, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: createPromise
methods.description: Internal method to initialize the aggregate promise and set up its resolution logic.

methods.name: refillPending
methods.description: Refills the list of pending promises based on concurrency constraints.

methods.name: addPending
methods.description: Adds a new promise to the pending list by transforming the current iterable value into a promise, and attaches fulfillment/rejection callbacks.

methods.name: advanceIterator
methods.description: Advances the internal iterator safely, preventing recursive generator invocation.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Handles the completion of a pending promise, removes it, and potentially refills the pending list.

methods.name: checkIfFinished
methods.description: Checks whether all promises are settled and resolves the aggregate promise if so.
